Mara: Quick thread 1 benchmark visuals + webinar hook. Switch from avg-latency framing to reliability-first: show configs meeting 99th percentile SLAs vs unit cost.

Devin: Agree. Customers ask "will it stay snappy at peak?" not "what's the mean".

Sam: Design asks: 3 tiles
- Tile A: SLA compliance curve (probability of 99th <= X ms vs $ per 1M tokens, lines per config)
- Tile B: cost waterfall per 100k requests (batching/cache/compute)
- Tile C: persona vignette (chat/search/embeddings) annotated tradeoffs

Leah: Can you drop a tiny CSV for Tile A?

Mara: Sure. CSV (latency_ms, small_batch, medium_batch, prefix_cache):
150,0.62,0.75,0.93
200,0.78,0.89,0.98
250,0.90,0.95,0.995
300,0.95,0.985,0.999
Costs per 1M tokens: small_batch=1200, medium_batch=850, prefix_cache=420

Tom: Nice. Add axis labels: "99th <= X ms" and "$ per 1M tokens" and overlay cost ticks.

Mara: Hero copy options:
1) Keep app snappy: 99th percentile latency under 250ms at predictable unit cost
2) Reduce per-query spend 2-3x while preserving tail latency
3) Guaranteed SLA-ready inference for chat, search, and embeddings

Sam: #2 is best for acquisition.

Leah: Webinar plan: live demo (app under load -> flip routing to cheaper variant + enable prefix cache -> show 99th stays within SLA and cost drops). 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A.

Devin: Eng can provide a traffic script + dashboard for 99th traces. ETA 3 days for recording-ready run.

Tom: Inbound routing: tag engaged leads ["lead:tail-sla", "lead:unit-econ", "lead:embeddings-efficiency"], nurture path: whitepaper -> 5-min demo -> sales config templates.

Mara: Action items: design produce visuals by EOD Thu; content one-pager + webinar script; growth wire tags in HubSpot. Drop PNGs and trace logs here when ready and I'll lock hero claim by Fri.

marketing-bot: Sprint milestone "benchmark-sla-visuals" created, due in 10 days. :rocket:
